svg.text: Decision flow: "NCCL is slow between two nodes" on RoCE and on InfiniBand
Same opening move on both fabrics (perftest per rail); the tracks diverge at the congestion step

g.title: nccl-tests busbw at 60% of reference between dgx-01 and dgx-02
g.text: nccl-tests busbw at 60% of reference between dgx-01 and dgx-02

g.title: ib_write_bw per rail pair: one rail low, others ~line rate ?
g.text: ib_write_bw per rail pair: one rail

g.title: Step 1
Half rate (~196 of 400) or physical errors on that rail ?
Step 2

svg.text: No: 5-10% low with retries = loss or congestion. Which fabric?

g.title: netq <leaf> show roce-counters: PFC Tx to the host rising ?
g.text: PFC Tx to the host rising ?

g.title: Step 3

g.text: No PFC, no ECN, still slow:
WJH drops of any type on

g.title: netq show wjh-drop buffer dst-port 4791: Tail drop ?
Step 4
WJH TC column = 3 (lossless) for the dropped packets ?
Step 5
PFC pause pegged at line rate with the link idle (storm) ?
g.text: PFC pause pegged at line rate

g.title: Step 6
nv show qos roce identical on every leaf (netq check roce) ?
g.text: nv show qos roce identical on

g.title: Step 7

g.text: Drift: a lossy leaf or other

g.title: PFC + ECN + DSCP consistent host to host
g.text: PFC + ECN + DSCP consistent host to host
perftest OK, WJH 4791 empty, busbw at reference

g.title: UFM events on the path: Symbol error / High BER / link down ?
g.text: UFM events on the path: Symbol

g.title: Step 3
perfquery -x on the leaf port: XmitWait rising, Symbol 0 ?
Step 4
ibtracert rail-N -> rail-N: one leaf hop as designed ?
Step 5
UFM SM: adaptive routing on, SHARP trees healthy ?
Step 6

g.text: AR off on a fat tree = static

g.title: UFM telemetry: XmitWait sawtooth aligned with all_reduce phases ?
Step 7
UFM Fabric Health clean after the change
g.text: UFM Fabric Health clean after the change
zero Speed/Width, High BER, routing warnings
